Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to gather the birth date of W. M. Harvey, a key piece of information needed to determine which director was older. The search queries used, including "W. M. Harvey birth date" and "Neal of the Navy W. M. Harvey birth," should have sought additional authoritative sources beyond what was visited (IMDb, Wikipedia, DuckDuckGo). Instead, WebSurfer relied on repeatedly searching the same sources without broadening the search strategy or reporting any concrete results for W. M. Harvey. Consequently, this critical omission hindered the determination of accurate ages for both directors and prevented the resolution of the task. This resembles an "incomplete synthesis" pattern, where gathering relevant but incomplete data causes the task to fail.
